messages.content: You look at one picture with no other context and describe exactly what is drawn, like a careful field naturalist. Do not guess what was intended; describe only what is visible. description: a free paragraph describing the whole creature first. parts: every body part you see, one entry each (head, horns, ears, mane, legs, feet, tail, wings, gills, tentacles, shell, plates, scales, feathers, markings), with what it looks like and where it is. attached_objects: anything that looks attached to or sitting on the body rather than part of it, such as an object, an armor piece or a whole small animal; empty if none. animals: every real animal whose features you can see, as everyday English common names, at most four; include any animal that only one part resembles. Then count, looking carefully: separate_bodies: separate animal bodies or body-shaped objects in the picture, including any whole animal or animal-shaped object attached to or sitting on the main creature. heads: heads of any kind. walking_legs: legs the creature stands or walks on, including hidden ones you can infer. wings: wings of any kind. extra_limb_pieces: jointed leg-like, claw-like or tentacle-like pieces other than the walking legs and the tail. tails: tails of any kind (0 if none).

message.content: {"animals": ["bear", "beetle"], "attached_objects": [], "description": "The creature is a stocky four-legged shaggy brown bear shown standing in profile facing right, with insect features merged into its body. Its body, head, ears, legs and paws are those of a brown bear with thick brown fur. Set into the fur of its shoulders, neck and side are several glossy dark reddish-brown beetle wing-covers, with large translucent tan membranous insect flight wings with brown veins extending outward from the sides of its torso. Rows of dark slit-like openings run along the fur on its flanks, and instead of a bear tail it has a long segmented armored dark insect tail with small spines and a forked tip hanging from its rear.", "extra_limb_pieces": 0, "heads": 1, "parts": [{"looks_like": "brown bear head with shaggy brown fur, brown eyes, tan muzzle and dark nose", "part": "head", "where": "at the front top of the body facing to the right"}, {"looks_like": "small rounded furry bear ears", "part": "ears", "where": "on top of the head"}, {"looks_like": "thick shaggy brown-furred bear legs", "part": "legs", "where": "under the body, two in front and two in rear supporting the body"}, {"looks_like": "broad furry bear paws with long pale claws", "part": "feet", "where": "at the ends of the legs on the ground"}, {"looks_like": "translucent tan membranous insect wings with brown veins", "part": "wings", "where": "extending outward from both sides of the torso, a large one on the visible left side and a smaller one on the far right side"}, {"looks_like": "glossy dark reddish-brown hard beetle wing-covers", "part": "shell", "where": "clustered and embedded in the fur on the shoulders, neck and side of the torso"}, {"looks_like": "rows of dark slit-like openings in the fur resembling insect breathing holes", "part": "markings", "where": "in two rows along the rear flank and mid-side of the torso"}, {"looks_like": "long segmented glossy dark brown armored insect tail with small side spines and a forked pointed tip", "part": "tail", "where": "at the rear of the body hanging down behind the hind legs"}], "separate_bodies": 1, "tails": 1, "walking_legs": 4, "wings": 2}
